title: Human migration has surged since 2000 – these maps reveal where people are going
summary: A Nature data journalism piece examining the significant increase in human migration since 2000, using interactive maps and visualizations to illustrate global population movement patterns and destinations.
problem_solved: Understanding and visualizing the complex patterns of global human migration flows over the past two decades
why_valuable: Provides accessible visual insights into demographic shifts that impact economies, politics, and societies worldwide
